headline: Amazon's new Echo Dot works as a Wi-Fi extender and smart home hub
summary: Amazon introduced a new Echo Dot that can serve as a Wi-Fi extender built on eero technology, alongside other smart home hub features. Outlets reporting on the device describe the same core functionality: an extended Wi-Fi network paired with smart home capabilities in Amazon's smart speaker lineup.
